text:
Stop praying scared. It never works.

Every time you're desperate, you pray. But you're shaking. Begging. All that panic doesn't disappear. It travels up.

What you send is what comes back. Fear answered with fear.

You think your prayers aren't being answered. They are. Exactly what you put in.

Pray like you've already won. Pray with faith or don't pray.
caption:
Your mindset when you pray determines what you get back.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #mindset #success #faith #growth
